P1780 Park/Neutral Position Switch Malfunction DTC (Only for A/T)
CIRCUIT DESCRIPTION
The park/neutral position switch goes on when the shift lever is in the Nor P shift position. When it goes on
terminal NSW of the ECM is grounded to body ground via the starter relay thus the terminal NSW voltage
becomes OV. When the shift lever is in the D, 2, L, or R position, the park/neutral position switch goes off,
so the voltage of ECM. Terminal NSW becomes battery positive voltage, the voltage of the ECM internal
power source.
If the shift lever is moved from the N position to the D position, this signal is used for air-fuel ratio correction
and for idle speed control (estimated control), etc.

INSPECTION PROCEDURE
HINT:
Read freeze frame data using TOYOTA hand-held tester or 08D II scan tool. Because freeze frame records
the engine conditions when the malfunction is detected, when troubleshooting it is useful for determining
whether the vehicle was running or stopped, the engine warmed up or not, the air-fuel ratio lean or rich, etc.
at the time of the malfunction.
